title: NSPredicate Formats
hints: Always substitute values with `%@`, passing arrays for `BETWEEN` and `IN`.
`NSPredicate(format: "title CONTAINS[cd] %@ OR body CONTAINS[cd] %@", text, text)`.
jsBridge: `NSPredicate(format:)` is a string query language (`title CONTAINS[cd] %@`), like writing SQL `WHERE` clauses or a MongoDB filter. It's checked only at runtime, which is why SwiftData's typed `#Predicate` exists.
